title: Romania's Fragile New Government Faces Twin Crises of Deficit and Inflation · 22 Oct
keywords: Romania, deficit, inflation, Luca Niculescu, minority government, European Commission, cost of living, fiscal consolidation, National Bank of Romania, EU excessive deficit procedure, political instability, GDP growth
notes: Romania has ended nearly six months of political paralysis with the approval of Luca Niculescu's minority cabinet, but the relief may be short-lived. The new government must reduce one of the European Union's largest deficits while citizens grapple with inflation running at 7.0 percent and near-zero economic growth. The central question is whether Bucharest can restore fiscal credibility without imposing the full cost on households already stretched by rising prices.
